summary: AutoFinishEncoder::drop panicked when try_finish() returned an error. The fix still attempts to finish the stream but discards the result, preventing this error-triggered panic. A unique verbatim implementation reversal is available. Blocked: the fix adds no tests, and no existing upstream test at this revision calls auto_finish or constructs AutoFinishEncoder. Existing frame tests explicitly finish their encoders and cannot detect this regression. No tests were run.
